# Vault of Tools
> A comprehensive, curated directory and comparison platform for discovering, evaluating, and reviewing leading Artificial Intelligence tools.

- Canonical Website: https://vaultoftools.com
- Directory: https://vaultoftools.com/discover
- Categories: https://vaultoftools.com/categories
- Comparisons: https://vaultoftools.com/compare
- Editorial & Insights: https://vaultoftools.com/blog

## Core Purpose
Vault of Tools aggregates and structures information about AI software products, Developer Tools, Machine Learning platforms, and Workflow Automation tools. It provides verified metadata, objective head-to-head feature matrices, pricing tiers, and community ratings.

## Primary Sections
- **AI Tool Directory (/discover)**: Filter tools by pricing (Free, Freemium, Paid), category, and features.
- **Tool Categories (/categories)**: Curated tool groupings including AI Writing, AI Coding, AI Design, Automation, Customer Support, and Business Intelligence.
- **Head-to-Head Comparisons (/compare)**: Side-by-side technical benchmarks (e.g., Claude 3.5 Sonnet vs ChatGPT-4o, Cursor vs GitHub Copilot).
- **In-Depth Guides (/blog)**: Benchmark analyses, migration guides, and workflow productivity recommendations.
